description: I'm PitcheEshwar, a student from Chennai, India, building "The Earth Information Jukebox," a web app that turns NASA Earth data into real-time sound so people can hear climate change as well as see it. My skills include [JavaScript, Python, UI design], and I'm interested in accessibility, data visualization and audio. I'm looking for teammates with frontend (Web Audio API), data handling, UI design or sound design skills, and beginners are welcome.
